_comment: Copy to regress.json next to your manuscript and edit. Paths are relative to --root (default: this file's directory). Keys starting with _ are ignored. Every rule that stays unconfigured is reported as INFO 'NOT guarding' — fill it or accept that it guards nothing.
_src_dir: folder holding all source .md files (internal working files included)
_deliver_globs: globs (under src_dir) of the DELIVERED body only. Internal notes legitimately mention TODO and non-existent [99] — never scan them with body rules.
_skip_sections: a heading containing any of these starts a section that is dropped from the delivered approximation
_ref_list: numbered reference list file, lines like '[12] Author ...' — for numeric [12] citation style. null if you use BibTeX.
_bib_files: e.g. ["references.bib"] — enables the @key dangling / orphan check
_pii: adapt to your country; pii_skip_before = regex that, right before a match, marks an official document number rather than personal data
_ledger: ONE numbers ledger per project (markdown table or TSV; see numbers-ledger.template.md). Drives R-STALE (stale value returns -> FAIL) and R-LEDGER (current value missing -> WARN).
_entities: R-ATTR: e.g. names of works by others / students, marks = accepted attribution words ('supervised', 'co-created'). A paragraph naming an entity without a mark FAILs.
_banned_claims: R-CORR: [["wrong phrase exactly as it appeared", "why it is wrong + where verified (date)"], ...]
